entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to process a return for an order I placed a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet, delivered on November 1, 2025. Is that correct?
Okay. And just to understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. The color wasn't quite what I expected, and it just doesn't match my bike. I never even took it out of the packaging, the box is unopened.

I understand. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see here that you received the item 84 days ago, which is within our 10-day return window. I cannot approve this return for a full refund.

That's great news, I appreciate that. Now, since I'll be packaging it up and sending it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase? I do need a new helmet, and getting the right gear is really important for safety.

I'm glad I could process the return for you. While I can't provide a discount code on this transaction, I can confirm the return shipping is completely free. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on your account. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Alright, I understand. Free shipping is fair enough. Thanks for your help today, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, you'll see the refund processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
